name: Code Firewall MCP
description: A security filter that blocks dangerous code patterns by comparing normalized structural syntax trees against a blacklist of known threats using vector embeddings. It acts as a gatekeeper to prevent malicious code execution by identifying dangerous structures regardless of specific identifiers or literals.
